messages:
Leo (Finance): Heads-up 59 - AWS Marketplace applied the wrong pricing tier for reseller 'NorthStar Partners' on Apr 1 invoice. They were billed at list tier instead of partner discount tier. Partner flagged duplicated SKU charge.
Marta (Billing Ops): Can you paste the invoice lines? I can check our ingestion mapping and AWS settlement file.
Leo (Finance): Snippet from invoice export:
```
invoice_id,sku,desc,qty,unit_price,ext_amount
INV-87901,ML-API-UNIT,ml inference units,10000,0.05,500.00
INV-87901,ML-API-UNIT,ml inference units (partner discount expected),10000,0.035,350.00
```
Looks like both lines exist: list price and discounted price, so double-billed $350. Partner says their contract is 30% off list.
Jorge (SalesOps): Oof. Contract clearly shows 30% off list. Partner has been escalated to AE. They want invoice frozen and a corrective credit.
Priya (Accounting): If we freeze, cash application needs note. We can put invoice on hold (AR hold) but need approval from Kara for >$1k exposures. Also need to record a payable to partner for the duplicate $350 and create an adjusting journal to contra-revenue 4210.
aws-marketplace-bot: Automated reconciliation notice: duplicate SKU detected for account northstar-acct on settlement date 2026-04-01. Case opened with AWS: 03-774210.
Marta (Billing Ops): I'll re-run ingestion rule 'aws-sku-dedupe-v2' and check mapping. If it's a Marketplace reporting bug we'll request AWS refund and issue partner credit. ETA on their side per case is 7 business days.
Leo (Finance): Partner is asking to not escalate to collections and wants their April payment to reflect the correction. They'd prefer a credit memo rather than waiting for AWS. Any objections to issuing an internal credit pending AWS?
Kara (Manager): Approve temporary credit memo up to $1,000 pending AWS settlement. Require a support case link + partner ack and a reversing journal when AWS issues refund. Approve: Kara "+1".
Priya (Accounting): Noted. GL for provisional credit: 4210 (partner credits). Tag with project 'marketplace-reseller' and add memo 'provisional credit pending AWS refund case 03-774210'.
Jorge (SalesOps): I'll send partner confirmation: "We will apply a provisional credit of $350 to INV-87901; this will appear on your Apr invoice. Once AWS confirms refund we will finalize records." Want me to include the invoice snippet?
Marta (Billing Ops): Yes include the snippet and case number. Also I'll add a follow-up reminder to FIN-3205 in 10 business days.
Leo (Finance): Created FIN ticket FIN-3205: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3205. Attached settlement file and partner email.
aws-marketplace-bot: Notification: AWS case 03-774210 created; expected response window 5-8 business days.
Jorge (SalesOps): Sent partner confirmation, cc Finance & Accounting. Partner replied: "Thanks -- applying the credit on Apr invoice works for us. Please keep us posted on AWS."
Priya (Accounting): Will post provisional credit to AR and create reversing journal entry template.
Leo (Finance): Closing thread for now. Will reopen if AWS resolution differs. :white_check_mark:
